keyFindings.text: **P2 · Medium impact · Medium effort — hard-rules overlay contract.** Keep installed rules authoritative. Put repository additions at the fixed root path `.sk-git/hard-rules.json`; load it only after an operator-owned trust decision keyed to the canonical repository path and remote identity. Never let repository config self-authorize trust or steer the overlay path. Merge in deterministic order: built-ins first, then additions. Permit only registered existing checks and `warn` severity; require repository-namespaced IDs; reject duplicates against built-ins and within the overlay. Reject symlinks, traversal and oversize files. On parse, schema, check or ID failure, ignore the overlay as a unit while retaining built-ins and report the invalid state. The setup battery should display built-in count, overlay count, and one explicit state: absent, active, ignored-untrusted or invalid. This is needed because the current dispatch loader reads one sibling sidecar, returns an empty list on read/parse/shape errors, skips unknown checks and treats throwing checks as passed; the advisory resolves the inspected repository's skill path, while the setup battery checks the installed copy [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/dispatch/lib/dispatch-rule-checks.mjs:14] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/dispatch/lib/dispatch-rule-checks.mjs:18] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/dispatch/lib/dispatch-rule-checks.mjs:21] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/dispatch/lib/dispatch-rule-checks.mjs:280] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/dispatch/lib/dispatch-rule-checks.mjs:287] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-git/scripts/hooks/git-preflight-advisory.mjs:106] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-git/scripts/hooks/git-preflight-advisory.mjs:107] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-git/scripts/hooks/git-preflight-advisory.mjs:108] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/git-setup-check.cjs:524] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/git-setup-check.cjs:526].
